market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC trading ~$79,600-$80,400 on May 8-9, 2026, with month-to-date range roughly $79,700-$82,300. To resolve Yes, BTC needs to print a low at or below $75,000 — about 6% below current. With 22 days remaining and BTC's typical monthly range of 10-15%, hitting that level is plausible but not the base case. Sentiment is weak (BTC -18% YoY) and momentum already toward lower bound, supporting moderate Yes probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Direction of macro/risk-on sentiment over remaining 3 weeks; a bounce to $85k would lock in No while a fresh deleverage could quickly hit $75k.
